overall: The AG found the Council violated the Open Meeting Law by missing the 14-business-day deadline to respond to an earlier complaint, found the violation intentional, and declined a separate fine because OML 2017-45 already imposed a $1,000 fine.

allegations.summary: Complainant alleged the Council failed to respond to an earlier Open Meeting Law complaint within the 14-business-day deadline required by law.
allegations.key_passage: Here, the Council exceeded the 14 business day time frame for responding to the complaint and did not request an extension of time from our office.
